description.value:
Grafted adrenal tissue with no sense of restraint. Activation — 1 action, 3/day: gain 10 temporary Hit Points and a +10-foot status bonus to Speed for 1 minute. When it ends you are fatigued until you next rest.

Donor: Whoever this came from lived at a redline. It still wants to.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole effect is a limited-use (3/day) activated action granting 10 temp HP and a +10-ft status Speed bonus for 1 minute, then fatigued -- a limited-use activated ability needs a new frequency-tracked action item, not a rule element on this equipment card (same architecture gap as the mutations pass's Loyal-Blood/Second-Wind-Lung).
